response.overview: Kackerus e ranga amen ngame gae amea Skomott ama ian anubumin. Epwodu ranga, Kackerus ma Sshickx omo amen e ranga engame gae egor ameb won tsimine bank information.  Me amea Skomott e ranga, naga amen ranga, King Mjeyjohn ma Queen Eve won tsimine riri engame tsimine mon eba kadi ekaie egor won ameb. Mjeyjohn re iow ekaae iow omo. Monza won tsimine guard, Acxen won tsimine computer, ma Dinyo emen ekaae kadi amen ranga.  Kackerus ma Kombiy won tsimine ritual ekaae baka, me ameb e ranga ekaae iow. Skomott eba omo iow dorerin Mjeyjohn ma Eve won engame. Kackerus gae e baka.
response.title: The Sovereign Trap
